blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Coach Tim Cone expects Gilas Pilipinas to keep the same core, alongside newly minted naturalized player Bennie Boatwright, as Gilas resumes its Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers campaign later this month. Gilas is set to arrive in Malaysia on Nov. 21 to begin preparations for the fifth window of qualification in Seremban, with the players from the PBA joining those from B.League and the Korean Basketball League. “It’s going to be pretty much the usual suspects. Might be a surprise here and there, but you’re going to see generally the usual suspects,” Cone said after steering Barangay Ginebra to the PBA […]...
